snapshot.date_policy: Preserve original registry date strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED labels; no day/month/year imputation. Training excludes partial dates.
snapshot.missingness_policy: Source-missing values remain missing. criteria_count and text_complexity are not invented.
limitations: Not a frozen historical baseline snapshot.
Not a population-representative or exhaustive registry export.
Completed-trial restriction creates selection bias; no censored trials are represented.
Results support a reproducible retrospective workflow demonstration, not validated prospective or clinical claims.
The live API may change. Exact bundled-data reproduction uses the preserved raw responses and checksums.

cohort.outcomes: completed actual completion minus start date in days

temporal_cutoffs.policy: Whole start-date groups. Training/validation outcomes strictly precede the next split's start cutoff. No refit on validation.

target.positive_rule: duration_days > training quantile; ties are non-prolonged

recommendation.reason: Lowest validation Brier score among enabled fitted models; exact ties use model name. Test data are not used. This risk recommendation does not establish the best duration regressor or prospective clinical validity.

pci.interpretation: Descriptive cohort-relative index, not a validated probability or clinical score. Missing values use training medians; constant training components contribute zero.

warning: Research decision support only. Completed-only cohort creates follow-up/selection bias; minimum sample guard is not evidence of scientific validity. RETROSPECTIVE SNAPSHOT: baseline feature availability is unverified; post-start registry updates and narrative text may leak outcome information. Do not claim prospective validation.
limitations: Validation metrics are optimistic after hyperparameter and model selection; test metrics are the held-out estimate. Validation bootstrap intervals do not correct selection optimism and do not guarantee coverage.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models and assume independent trials; they do not include model-fitting uncertainty or sponsor/site clustering.
Classifier probabilities are not post-hoc calibrated; reliability bins and Brier score assess calibration.
Nonlinear structured branches and linear modalities share retained cohorts, but have different model capacities. Additional complexity does not guarantee improved performance.
Tree impurity importances describe global fitted-model behavior, can favor high-cardinality features, and are neither trial-specific SHAP values nor causal evidence.
Text uses TF-IDF; BioBERT, survival, and SHAP are optional separate capabilities and are not claimed as executed.
Completed-only analysis cannot estimate outcomes of censored/ongoing trials without a separate survival cohort.

Per-phase test metrics are exploratory; small or one-class subgroups can yield unstable or undefined metrics. Scatter plots retain at most 200 evenly spaced chronological rows; metrics and reliability bins use every retained row.
